environment.hostOS: Windows with Docker Desktop / WSL2 Linux containers
environment.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 5.1.9-0+deb12u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
environment.ffprobe: ffprobe version 5.1.9-0+deb12u1 Copyright (c) 2007-2026 the FFmpeg developers

methodology.scope: Unmodified Go HTTP backend -> real yt-dlp download over container loopback -> real FFmpeg stream copy -> HTTP download; generated media, not live X/Twitter
methodology.pacing: A new request starts in a different Unix second from the previous request to avoid the application filename collision; pacing is excluded from latency, and throughput is not claimed.
methodology.latency: clipReadyMs: POST /clip through complete JSON response; clipAndDownloadMs also includes fetching the returned MP4. Probing, hashing, full decoding, fixture generation, warmup, and pacing are outside both timers.
methodology.percentile: p95 uses nearest rank; median averages the middle two samples for an even count.
methodology.network: Docker --network none; local HTTP only. No internet media, cookies, personal videos, or download-tool mocks.
